Package com.eloview.sdk.eloview

Class EloView

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.consts.Consts
com.eloview.sdk.accountManager.AccountManager
com.eloview.sdk.eloview.EloView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class EloView extends AccountManager
EloView class provides the below operations.
  • A method to set the content that needs to be played on the device in EloView control mode when the device is is offline or not registered to an account setOfflinePlayContent
  • A method to get the type of content (apk/web view) and name of the content set on the device in EloView Control mode getPlayContent
  • A method to return the status of the current play content on the device in EloView control mode getPlayContentStatus
  • A method to get the current connection status of the device with EloView cloud (online/offline) getDeviceCloudStatus
  • A method to toggle the WiFi state in Elo QuickSettings. This method also toggles the WiFi state in Android Home Mode. toggleWifi
  • A method to toggle the Bluetooth in Elo QuickSettings. This method also toggles the Bluetooth state in Android Home Mode. toggleBT

    • setOfflinePlayContent

      public String setOfflinePlayContent(String packageName)
      This method is used to set content on the device in EloView control mode when device is offline or not registered to an account. If the device comes online and content is set through EloView, it will override the content set through this API.
      Parameters:
      packageName - Package to be set as default content on the device.
      Returns:
      status message indicating success or failure

    • getPlayContent

      public String getPlayContent()
      This method returns the type of content and name of the content set on the device. This method works only in EloView control mode.
      Returns:
      the play content information or error message

    • getPlayContentStatus

      public String getPlayContentStatus()
      This method returns the status of play content on the device in control mode. The status can be one of the following strings. YET_TO_DOWNLOAD DOWNLOADING DOWNLOADED INSTALLING INSTALLED DOWNLOAD_FAILED INSTALL_FAILED UNKNOWN_STATUS
      Returns:
      the play content status string

    • getDeviceCloudStatus

      public String getDeviceCloudStatus()
      This method returns device's online/offline status. The status can be one of the following strings. "Online " "Offline " "Connecting " "Reconnecting " "Online ( Not Provisioned )
      Returns:
      the device cloud status string

    • toggleWifi

      public int toggleWifi(boolean isEnableWifi)
      This method is used to toggle the wifi in Quicksettings (EloView mode). It can also be used to toggle Wifi in Android Home mode.
      Parameters:
      isEnableWifi - Sending boolean for enabling/disabling wifi in Quicksettings.
      Returns:
      result code indicating success or failure

    • switchToAndroidHomeMode

      public boolean switchToAndroidHomeMode()
      This method is used to switch to Android home mode from EloView mode. There is no way to switch back to EloView mode without a factory reset so use with caution.
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful, false otherwise

    • switchToAndroidHomeMode

      public boolean switchToAndroidHomeMode(boolean isRebootNeeded, boolean isAndroidHomeMode)
      This method is used to switch to Android home mode from EloView mode. This is same as switchToAndroidHomeMode() except that this accepts two boolean parameters There is no way to switch back to EloView mode without a factory reset so use with caution.
      Parameters:
      isRebootNeeded - : Boolean parameter for specifying whether reboot is needed or not.
      isAndroidHomeMode - : Boolean parameter for specifying Android Home flag.
      Returns:
      true if the operation was successful, false otherwise
